chunks: Intoxication is a burning coal of the Fire.

key_terms.اَلنَّارِ: the Fire, meaning Hellfire in this context

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about intoxication in this hadith?
ai.summary: This concise hadith strongly condemns intoxication by portraying it as something directly tied to the Fire. Its imagery serves as a moral warning, emphasizing the grave spiritual and ethical danger of becoming intoxicated.
